## Behavior

Describe the tool or fix and its configuration requirements. Preserve artwork and FUD TXN BOT Coming Soon.

## Evidence

List checks actually run, failures and limitations. Ordinary CI needs no funded wallet or production key.

## Transaction changes (if applicable)

Describe exact instruction/account validation, shared gate integration, simulations, caps, authorization, duplicate/uncertain outcomes and post-state verification. Distinguish fixture/local simulation from funded mainnet evidence. Do not attach secrets or private acceptance data.
